facts.text: Voyager 1 Interstellar Spacecraft was deployed at Interstellar Space (Beyond Heliopause) during Voyager Interstellar Mission in 1977.

722-kilogram deep-space explorer featuring a 3.7-meter parabolic high-gain antenna dish, tubular truss structure, and 13-meter magnetometer boom. Currently cruising through interstellar space at 17 km/s.
Engineered specifically to operate in the harsh vacuum and extreme temperatures of the deep-space environment.
Discovered active volcanism on Jupiter's moon Io, complex braided structures in Saturn's rings, and became the first probe to enter true interstellar space in 2012.
A permanent human and robotic monument celebrating space exploration in deep space.
